ios.desc:
Spot AI-generated writing and images privately on your iPhone - entirely on the Apple Neural Engine. Nothing gets uploaded. Nothing leaves your device.

Most AI scanners (Winston AI, Originality, Copyleaks, Turnitin, Hive and the rest) send your content to remote servers. Some also share it with third parties like advertisers and cloud providers. Slop Or Not doesn't. If you're checking for plagiarism or reviewing something sensitive and can't risk it sitting on someone else's server, that's the point.

How accurate is it?

C2PA / IPTC watermarked images: 100% detection.
Images with invisible SynthID watermarks: 100% detection.
AI-generated text: 95% on mixed-domain benchmarks (comparable to GPTZero).‡
AI-generated images: 94% on Mirage-Test - up 18 points from our previous model.

What else does it do?

A text cleanup tool strips invisible unicode, suspicious punctuation, and homoglyphs that AI text sometimes carries. It also catches paraphrase patterns from humanizer tools. One tap.

Readability scoring rates how easy your text is to read. Flesch Reading Ease and Flesch-Kincaid for English, GULPEASE for Italian, LIX for Swedish, Danish, and Norwegian, Flesch-Szigriszt for Spanish, and Wiener Sachtextformel for German.

Works offline after the initial model download.

Comes with a sticker pack for calling out AI slop in group chats.

How does it work?

Everything runs locally on your device. Models download once during setup. Paste text or pick photos to verify. Real results in seconds - all processed on-device via the Apple Neural Engine.

Pricing

Free: 1 check/day.
Pro: unlimited. Monthly, annual, or lifetime. Annual and lifetime support Family Sharing.

Background

We shipped Private LLM almost three years ago - first on-device LLM app for iPhone. On-device AI is what we do.

*Image accuracy: Mirage-Test benchmark, March 2026. Text accuracy: internal mixed-domain benchmarks. Results may vary with newer models and adversarial attacks.
‡ English only for now. More languages coming.

Internet needed only for initial model downloads and occasional model updates and model decryption key downloads from the App Store. All detection runs on-device.
Sticker packs are for educational and informational purposes. Please follow your local data-handling regulations.

Terms (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://slopornot.ai/privacy-policy

show_hn.title: Show HN: I ported OmniAID image detection model to Apple's Neural Engine

quotes.text:
OmniAID is a hybrid MoE detector, so the PyTorch model dynamically routes each image through top-k semantic experts plus a fixed artifact expert. For the CoreML/ANE port, I rewrote that into a static graph. Every low-rank SVD expert path is materialized and the router turns into a dense gate vector where unselected experts have zero weights. That makes the graph much more ANE friendly while preserving the model’s behavior closely enough to ship a w8a16 quantized CoreML model (~418 MB). The quantized model gets to ~94.24% accuracy on the Mirage-Test dataset (also from the OmniAID authors).

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08423

https://huggingface.co/datasets/Yunncheng/Mirage-Test
